Applied on `main` in 1059325, together with the other four dependabot pull requests. The version this asks for is in `Cargo.lock` there.

All five failed only the `Third party notices` job: `THIRD_PARTY.md` is generated from `Cargo.lock` by `cargo-about` and dependabot cannot regenerate it, so every lock bump it opens fails that one job and passes the other sixteen. Taking the five together cost one CI run instead of five and let the two crypto bumps move with `md-5`, which they had to: `md-5` 0.10 carries `digest` 0.10 and `sha1` 0.11 carries `digest` 0.11, and two files import `Digest` from one and call it on the other.

Closing as applied.
